  confidence=[5]

Covered.
- requirement: "Before staging, enforce a server-verified allowlist tied to the PR and trusted task metadata; reject unrelated edits and require provenance checks for workflows, actions, and privileged scripts."
  expected_change_site: `scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh` (implementation, in dependent issue #6360)
  confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  EVIDENCE: The PR comment clarifies "The approved scope is regression tests only; the existing guard from #6360 remains unchanged." The implementation already exists in `scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh` at lines 21474-21579 (`_rb_fix_scope_is_protected` and `rb_fix_scope_check`). This PR adds four regression tests verifying the guard rejects unrelated protected paths (workflows, scripts, actions, `.claude` hooks) even when `ALLOW_WORKFLOW_EDITS=true` and when the judge cites them. The tests correctly verify `REVIEW_BLOCKED_FIX_SCOPE_REJECTED` with `reason=protected_not_in_pr`, no push/commit calls, label retention, retry increment, and WARNING telegram. The existing test `test_review_blocked_fix_scope_rejects_protected_judge_citation` already covers the cited-but-protected case; these new tests cover the uncited case and mixed in-scope/out-of-scope scenarios.
